purpose: Honor the app with the strongest user traction and growth momentum during the event.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. RevenueCat-reported total revenue during the submission period determines the shortlist; the highest revenue does not automatically win.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android release; eligible store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Describe post-launch growth work and dated results such as downloads, revenue, active users, conversion, retention, waitlist growth, MRR/ARR, social reach, or community engagement.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Early and Effective Release | 2 Growth by numbers
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to the stronger Early and Effective Release score, then Growth by numbers. Revenue shortlisting occurs before scored judging.
judge_observable_proof: A live early release, experiment chronology, acquisition and retention actions, concrete results, lessons, and next steps.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Launch early enough to generate RevenueCat revenue and run attributable product, pricing, retention, and acquisition experiments.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Reward the most compelling public build journey and the product learning created by public response.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Publish during the submission period; submit links to visible posts. Use #Shipaton and #BuildInPublic. The rules contain two conflicting start times; use August 1, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. PT as the conservative start.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible live app except the rules' Next Gen exemption if another category is also entered; public social or community accounts and posts.
required_submission_evidence: Links to accounts and specific posts; explain how public building helped through motivation, feedback, ideas, or product changes.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Sharing your story | 2 Engagement | 3 Lessons Learned
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to Sharing your story, then Engagement, then Lessons Learned. Audience size is explicitly irrelevant.
judge_observable_proof: A dated artifact-to-response-to-decision-to-change-to-lesson chain, not merely posting frequency.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Sustained public documentation, feedback capture, consent-safe sharing, and a change log that connects feedback to product decisions.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Recognize the best mobile game shipped during the event.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. The submission must be a game.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Describe gameplay, art direction, and why monetization fits the genre; show real gameplay on device.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Fun and engagement | 2 Unique gameplay, progression, or replayability | 3 Monetization
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to fun and engagement, then uniqueness/progression/replayability, then monetization.
judge_observable_proof: Responsive controls, core loop, feedback, difficulty or progression, replay value, art direction, and an in-context purchase or ad experience.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Game feel, content balance, art/audio, performance, and genre-appropriate economy require more iteration than a utility demo.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Recognize the project with the strongest positive social impact.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Explain the individuals, community, or society served and how the app was designed to create benefit; include early usefulness or adoption evidence when available.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Impact | 2 Feasibility
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to Impact, then Feasibility.
judge_observable_proof: A specific beneficiary, credible mechanism of benefit, safe workflow, realistic delivery, and either broad reach or deep value to a smaller group.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Domain expertise, safeguarding, accessibility, privacy, evidence quality, and careful claims are often central dependencies.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Celebrate product craft, innovative interaction, visual design, and animation apart from business viability.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Describe unique design elements and point judges to specific screens, interactions, gestures, animations, or technical innovations; show them in motion.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Innovative ideas | 2 Aesthetics
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to Innovative ideas, then Aesthetics.
judge_observable_proof: A distinctive behavior or technical design, coherent hierarchy, delightful motion, smooth gestures, polished states, and accessible feedback.
unique_effort_or_dependency: High-fidelity interaction work, performance tuning, motion, haptics, accessibility, and a video that makes craft visible.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Reward the most creative and effective use of RevenueCat Ads.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. RevenueCat Ads must be used as a monetization method.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible app release plus a working RevenueCat Ads integration; other RevenueCat purchase methods may coexist.
required_submission_evidence: Explain where ads appear, why the placement is natural or additive, and how ads fit subscriptions, purchases, trials, and the wider revenue stack; provide early performance or experience signals when available.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Natural, useful, or additive ad integration | 2 Fit with audience, use case, and broader revenue model
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to integration quality, then strategic fit.
judge_observable_proof: Ads that unlock, fund, or enrich value without breaking the core flow, plus a coherent relationship to paid options.
unique_effort_or_dependency: RevenueCat Ads availability and implementation, ad-supply policy, consent and privacy, placement testing, measurement, and brand-safety risk.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Recognize the best student-built app through a lower-friction, code-and-video path.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: You must be an active student in high school, college, university, bootcamp, or another academic program and use a qualifying academic email. RevenueCat and sponsor employees remain limited to Conflict of Interest.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: No paid Apple or Google developer account or store release is required. Submit a working project for an eligible platform, integrate RevenueCat purchases or Ads, and provide a public open-source repository with a visible license and all code, assets, and instructions.
required_submission_evidence: Demo video; public repository; visible open-source license; text description; repository must be sufficient for the project to function. The rules exempt this category from store URL, free-trial or promo-code, and store testing requirements.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Idea clarity, usefulness, interest, or originality | 2 Meaningful progress and visible core functionality | 3 Thoughtful RevenueCat use | 4 Technical choices, product thinking, build and presentation care
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to the idea score, then progress, RevenueCat use, and technical/product/presentation care.
judge_observable_proof: A clear problem or experience, functioning core flow in the video, inspectable code, thoughtful monetization or ads, and sound implementation decisions.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Student and email verification, repository hygiene, licensing, setup documentation, and a demo that substitutes for store testing.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; a student project may also enter one Influencer Award if otherwise eligible.

purpose: Recognize the smartest use of RevenueCat to build a credible, differentiated, scalable business.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible store release with RevenueCat powering a purchase; Ads may be part of a broader mix.
required_submission_evidence: Describe how the app makes money, the paywall, pricing, packaging, conversion or revenue results, and why the model fits the product and market.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Clear, integrated, realistic, scalable revenue streams | 2 Creative or diverse monetization beyond a standard single model | 3 Revenue articulation, differentiation, competitive advantage, and long-term sustainability
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to clarity and fit, then creativity, then financial viability and differentiation.
judge_observable_proof: Free and paid value boundaries, pricing and packaging in the product, purchase flow, conversion or economics, and a credible link between value, cost, and revenue.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Pricing research, paywall implementation, entitlement states, restoration, experiments, analytics, and unit-economics evidence.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Recognize the best overall eligible app from RevenueCat or category-sponsor employees.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: Only otherwise eligible RevenueCat or sponsor employees may compete. Those employees are eligible for this award only; ordinary entrants are ineligible.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible platform and release requirements still apply unless an official clarification grants an exemption; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Global submission package and any category-specific explanation requested by the form.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 App Concept | 2 Execution | 3 Monetization
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to App Concept, then Execution, then Monetization.
judge_observable_proof: A novel or fun concept, reliable polished execution, interesting UX or animation, and a strong or novel monetization strategy.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Employment verification and strict conflict-of-interest handling; no cash prize is listed.
influencer_coexistence: No in practice; sponsor and RevenueCat employees are eligible only for this award.

purpose: Build a polished tool that lets Apple power users quickly save, organize, and retrieve reusable text, files, documents, and images.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. A project may enter only one Influencer Award. Do not use the influencer's identity, brand, voice, image, or likeness without written permission.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: An Apple-platform app is functionally required by the prompt; release to an eligible Apple store. RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: State this Influencer category and explain how the app serves the named audience; show fast capture, organization, and retrieval across supported Apple contexts.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Product focus and speed | 2 Organization and intelligent features | 3 Design and polish
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to focus and speed, then organization/intelligence, then polish.
judge_observable_proof: Low-friction save and retrieval for snippets, images, files, and documents; useful intelligence; clear, polished Apple-native behavior.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Apple share extensions, file and document handling, search/indexing, sync, permissions, and power-user performance may dominate scope.
influencer_coexistence: No second Influencer Award; yes to eligible non-Influencer awards.

award_name: Nutrition & Healthy Eating — Abbey's Kitchen Influencer Award
purpose: Help people make meals more satisfying through flexible, compassionate support without calorie counting, macro tracking, or restrictive plans.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. A project may enter only one Influencer Award. Do not use the influencer's identity, brand, voice, image, or likeness without written permission.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: State this Influencer category and explain how the app serves the audience; demonstrate practical meal support and the absence of calorie, macro, or restrictive-plan mechanics.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Practical nutrition support | 2 Compassionate flexibility | 3 Usefulness
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to practical support, then compassionate flexibility, then usefulness.
judge_observable_proof: Real-life meal guidance that is additive and flexible, non-restrictive language, and a useful next action.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Qualified nutrition review, eating-disorder-safe language, allergy and medical boundaries, cultural flexibility, and trustworthy content.
influencer_coexistence: No second Influencer Award; yes to eligible non-Influencer awards.

award_name: Career Coaching — Leadership Heather Influencer Award
purpose: Help new managers practise difficult workplace conversations, receive useful feedback, and build confidence before the real situation.

required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: State this Influencer category and explain how the app serves new managers; show realistic practice for feedback, boundaries, and saying no, plus actionable feedback.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Realistic scenarios | 2 Active practice and useful feedback | 3 Confidence building
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to scenario realism, then practice/feedback, then confidence.
judge_observable_proof: A believable conversation, active rehearsal, specific feedback tied to the user's words or choices, and a safe confidence-building progression.

influencer_coexistence: No second Influencer Award; yes to eligible non-Influencer awards.

award_name: Gaming — Mr Lewis Blogs Gaming Influencer Award
purpose: Create an enjoyable gaming bucket list that makes discovery, organization, completion, rating, and sharing easy.

required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads; lawful game metadata source.
required_submission_evidence: State this Influencer category and explain how the app serves the audience; show save-at-discovery, backlog organization, completion, rating, and sharing.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Discovery and organization | 2 Completion and sharing | 3 Enjoyment
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to discovery and organization, then completion/sharing, then enjoyment.

award_name: Yoga & Fitness — Simone Sharice Influencer Award
purpose: Turn a user's movement, Pilates, recovery, and wellness needs into one clear, achievable plan for today.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. A project may enter only one Influencer Award. Do not use the influencer's identity, brand, voice, image, or likeness without written permission.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Eligible iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Android store release; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: State this Influencer category and explain how the app serves the audience; demonstrate personalization, today's plan, and information restraint.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Personalization | 2 Daily clarity | 3 Information restraint
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to personalization, then daily clarity, then information restraint.
judge_observable_proof: Inputs meaningfully change today's safe plan; the next action is obvious; the user is not overloaded.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Movement content, safety review, personalization inputs, recovery boundaries, accessibility, and daily plan generation quality.
influencer_coexistence: No second Influencer Award; yes to eligible non-Influencer awards.

purpose: Recognize a creative, polished, high-quality app built for both iOS and Android with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, or both.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Both iOS and Android builds must be published. Optional community sharing and ecosystem contribution can add judging value.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Kotlin Multiplatform and/or Compose Multiplatform; live Apple App Store URL and Google Play URL; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Explain KMP/CMP use; provide both store URLs; link public build content; if claiming a contribution, link the library, pull request, documentation, sample, tool, or reusable component.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Cross-platform quality | 2 Community interaction, optional | 3 Contribution to the community, optional
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to cross-platform quality. Optional community interaction and contribution resolve later ties if scored.
judge_observable_proof: Stable, polished, consistent experiences on both platforms; effective sharing with native seams where needed; useful build content or contribution if claimed.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Dual store review, two-platform QA, KMP/CMP expertise, native interoperability, and time for optional public contribution.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Reward an app that captures attention through high-quality, repeatable content that converts into downloads.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. The app must be live and Noise must be used to promote and grow it during the event.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Live eligible app; Noise account and promotion; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Live app URL and the email associated with the Noise account; retain creative examples and conversion evidence even though the rules list only those two required fields.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Virality | 2 Scalability | 3 Conversion relevance
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to virality, then repeatability at scale, then how clearly creatives convey value and convert relevant attention.
judge_observable_proof: One or more viral or semi-viral posts, a repeatable creative or UGC playbook, clear value communication, and evidence connecting attention to downloads.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Noise workflow, content production volume, attribution, creative testing, permissions for UGC, and enough launch time to iterate.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Recognize a high-quality Galaxy Store app with thoughtful Samsung ecosystem optimization.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Publish on the Galaxy Store during Shipaton 2026 and follow Galaxy Store content rules. Galaxy exclusivity is optional bonus consideration.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Live Samsung Galaxy Store listing; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads; Galaxy-specific testing.
required_submission_evidence: Galaxy Store URL and an explanation of foldable support, Samsung-specific features, device optimization, and store-listing work.
ordered_judging_criteria: 80% standard applicable Shipaton criteria | 20% Galaxy optimization covering Samsung-specific features, foldables, multi-window, device-specific hardware, and Galaxy Store quality | Exclusivity bonus
tie_break_implication: Apply the standard applicable criteria in their existing order to 80% of the score. Galaxy optimization supplies 20%. Exclusivity can add bonus consideration but is not required.
judge_observable_proof: A polished Galaxy build and listing, foldable or multi-window behavior where relevant, device performance, and Samsung-specific value.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Galaxy Store account and review, Samsung hardware coverage, foldable and multi-window QA, store assets, and possible exclusivity tradeoff.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Reward a Replit-built app that moves from a new idea to a live, monetizing product with returning payers and growing transactions.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Build and publish with Replit, and integrate RevenueCat using Replit Agent.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Live mobile app; Replit project and preview; Replit Agent RevenueCat integration; RevenueCat transactions.
required_submission_evidence: At least three public posts showing different build stages; Replit preview URL and username; explain how Replit took the app from idea to a live monetizing product.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Growth momentum, primary | 2 Traction | 3 Craft | 4 Social pull
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to week-over-week revenue and transaction trajectory, then gross revenue/payers, craft, and community buzz.
judge_observable_proof: Returning paying users, consistent weekly transaction and revenue growth, a complete polished product, and a public build story.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Replit implementation constraints, clean RevenueCat integration, early launch, cohort and transaction instrumentation, and at least three public artifacts.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Reward a thoughtful messaging experience that gives users a valuable reason to return.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Publish a live app, integrate OneSignal, and deploy at least one campaign through the API, MCP, or dashboard.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Working OneSignal integration and deployed campaign; OneSignal App ID; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: OneSignal App ID and an explanation of the campaign or messaging experience. Preserve screenshots, segments, deep links, outcomes, and fatigue controls as proof.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Implementation | 2 User value | 3 Resourcefulness and creativity, including less-common or advanced features
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to implementation quality, then user value, then creative depth.
judge_observable_proof: A working message or Journey tied to a useful product moment, correct deep link and state handling, respectful timing, and measured outcome.
unique_effort_or_dependency: Permission timing, segmentation, campaign QA, deep linking, notification fatigue, privacy, and stable event or outcome instrumentation.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Reward disciplined growth testing, measurement, learning, and iteration rather than the largest audience.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Install and verify the Layers SDK before judging.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: Layers SDK in the submitted app; observable event or response signal; RevenueCat purchase integration or RevenueCat Ads.
required_submission_evidence: Explain Layers usage and verification; define the audience, message, channel or surface, experiment, and intended outcome; report the signal, learning, and next test.
ordered_judging_criteria: 1 Audience and growth hypothesis | 2 Layers-assisted growth loop | 3 SDK installation and observability | 4 Learning and iteration
tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to audience and hypothesis clarity, then loop design, observability, and learning.
judge_observable_proof: A specific audience, testable reason to care, focused experiment, verifiable signal, honest learning, and a credible next iteration.
unique_effort_or_dependency: SDK installation, event design, experiment logging, attribution, and enough time to observe and change the loop.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.

purpose: Recognize a high-volume, well-designed web-to-app purchase funnel using RevenueCat Funnels and Stripe.
category_specific_eligibility_and_disqua: All global gates apply. Launch a live web-to-app funnel using RevenueCat Funnels with Stripe as checkout.
required_platform_store_sdk_service_acco: RevenueCat Funnels; Stripe checkout; live web funnel; Stripe Project ID; app entitlement handoff; eligible app release.
required_submission_evidence: Live funnel URL and Stripe Project ID; preserve proof of the ad-click-to-checkout-to-download-to-entitlement path and qualifying payment volume.

tie_break_implication: A tie goes first to payment volume, then funnel design and conversion.

unique_effort_or_dependency: Web acquisition, Stripe and Funnel setup, identity and entitlement handoff, attribution, refunds and support, mobile deep links, and conversion optimization.
influencer_coexistence: Yes; an eligible project may also enter one Influencer Award.
